name: squid-swim
comment: WP-2.3 (squid). A 9x9 pool of still water (id 9; x, z in -4..4, y = 50..60, 11 deep) in a stone block (x, z in -5..5, y = 49..60), a stone ledge east of it at y = 60 (x 7..10, z -2..2); chunks within 3 preloaded; no player (no despawn, no spawner). Three squids (EntityList constructor; rotationVelocity drawn on the seeded rand, the oracle's join-hook redraw): 0 swims in the middle of the pool (EntitySquid.updatePlayerActionState's swim direction on 1-in-50 rolls, onLivingUpdate's stroke cycle and motion, isInWater's handleMaterialAcceleration over the shrunk box, called twice a tick, moveEntityWithHeading = moveEntity); 1 sits on the ledge (out of water: zero horizontal motion, gravity, a new direction every tick, the pitch sinking toward -90; it does not drown, canBreatheUnderwater); 2 drops into the pool from y = 66 and is killed at t = 300 by a direct hit of 20 (EntityLiving.attackEntityFrom with no attacker, then onDeath: EntitySquid.dropFewItems, 1-3 ink sacs, dye damage 0, which float in the water) and dies 20 ticks later. rng_state and entity_state of squid 0 every tick, entity_state of all every 5 ticks.
